Question: There is a Muslim school registered by government who is providing Islamic and modern education for Muslims and non-Muslims student and free education for poor students Muslim and non-Muslim. I want to know this school management can get or use zakat, sadaqatul-fitr, chaliswan and chirm-qurbani for education purposes. And that will be jayez? Answer ID: 3265 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 78/78=J) Zakah, Sadaqatul Fitr and price of Skin of Slaughtered animal of Qurbani must be given to the poor Muslims; otherwise the zakah will not be valid. Therefore, it is unlawful to utilize these amounts for educational purposes. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
